## Hypothesis

Extending VWAPCONT_DTE_OVERRIDE to ITM-2 strikes increases premium per contract, allowing us to maintain the minimum 3-lot floor even after DTE extension reduces contract count. This overcomes the sizing blocker that killed the 2DTE ATM variant (which fell to 1.6 contracts) while preserving the VWAP continuation edge's directional bias on J anchor days.

## Mechanism

Use VWAP_CONTINUATION setup with:
- Strike: ITM-2 put (for bearish J days) / ITM-2 call (for bullish, though J anchors are PUT-only)
- DTE: 2DTE (via `j_vwap_cont_dte_override=2` and `_expiry_for_setup` picker patch)
- Contract sizing: floor at 3 contracts (risk-based qty = max(3, floor(risk_per_trade / (premium × 100))))
- All other VWAP_CONTINUATION rules unchanged (chart-stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, TP1 at +100%, etc.)
